title: People domain observations for entity intelligence
description: Person-level Legistar votes reacquired from the publisher's own item-level records. Every row names the event item it was cast on, keeps the publisher's own vote label, and is classified without folding a recorded absence into an abstention. Exact numeric person ids only; fuzzy/name-only identity rows are excluded.
